story.titleZh: 车手健康问题持续，佩雷斯缺席粉丝论坛并休息，准备FP1和FP2比赛
story.summaryZh: 赛戈维亚·佩雷斯因健康问题将缺席粉丝论坛，并在上午休息后尝试参加FP1和FP2的比赛。瓦尔特里·博塔斯将在FP2中恢复参赛，基米·安东内利被认为身体状况良好，可以参加FP1。
story.originalTitle: Further illness issues among the drivers as Sergio Perez will not attend the fan forum and rest this morning before attempting to drive in FP1 and FP2...
story.summaryEn:
Further illness issues among the drivers as Sergio Perez will not attend the fan forum and rest this morning before attempting to drive in FP1 and FP2
Valtteri Bottas will be ready to return in FP2 as well after illness, while Kimi Antonelli is understood to be fit enough to drive in FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
车手们出现进一步的健康问题，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯将不会参加粉丝论坛，并在今天上午休息，之后尝试在FP1和FP2中驾驶
瓦尔特里·博塔斯将在FP2中准备好回归，因为他也生病了，而基米·安东内利据信身体状况足够良好，可以在FP1中驾驶 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
Further illness issues among the drivers as Sergio Perez will not attend the fan forum and rest this morning before attempting to drive in FP1 and FP2
Valtteri Bottas will be ready to return in FP2 as well after illness, while Kimi Antonelli is understood to be fit enough to drive in FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP
story.leadZh: 赛戈维亚·佩雷斯因健康问题将缺席粉丝论坛，并在上午休息后尝试参加FP1和FP2的比赛。瓦尔特里·博塔斯将在FP2中恢复参赛，基米·安东内利被认为身体状况良好，可以参加FP1。
